items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I couldn't even tell you nothing about Happy. I can't recall him, I can't even place him. I don't remember the guy that was. But I heard him talk about Happy

ctx.x: Yeah. Could you beat it off a little? For me? With your foot just so we can pick it up?

Let's see if I can get that. Most of their numbers was on the tempo like this. Like on the jump tempo. Put the microphone next to your foot out. I'll do it again then. Once it. That's most of the tempo, but they didn't play on the full full time like I'm playing. That guys, most of the drummers had that one beat. That was their beat, most of them. Whatever they played, they had that one beat. Now this guy, Faso, I say he was up until, the style he played now, he was playing a similar, you know, kind of the style…
Did you listen to many records when you were a kid?
